Brand identity & packaging

Pure Hive Honey

04 / 11

A little warmth. A clear identity.

An identity and packaging exploration for Pure Hive Honey. A geometric honey-inspired mark, warm amber tones, and a characterful wordmark bring the product and its visual identity together.

Design focus
Logo design, visual identity, packaging application
By
Eyilade Oridamisi

Rooted in the product

The mark references a honeycomb form and a flowing honey detail. The palette draws directly from the natural warmth of the product.

Made tangible

The identity is shown in a jar application, connecting the logo, label, and product photography as one composition.
